cover_selection_authorities_sql: CREATE TABLE cover_selection_authorities (selection_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(selection_id)='text' AND selection_id GLOB 'cover_selection_[0-9a-f]*' AND length(selection_id)=80), connection_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(connection_name)='text' AND length(CAST(connection_name AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), library_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(library_name)='text' AND length(CAST(library_name AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), item_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(item_id)='text' AND length(CAST(item_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 512), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('automatic','owner')), decision_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK((kind='automatic' AND decision_id GLOB 'automatic_decision_[0-9a-f]*' AND length(decision_id)=83) OR (kind='owner' AND decision_id GLOB 'human_decision_[0-9a-f]*' AND length(decision_id)=79)), consideration_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cover_considerations(consideration_id), supersedes_selection_id TEXT REFERENCES cover_selection_authorities(selection_id), occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(occurred_at)='integer' AND occurred_at>=0), document TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(document)='text' AND length(CAST(document AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 2 AND 131072), CHECK(supersedes_selection_id IS NULL OR supersedes_selection_id<>selection_id))
